messages:
maria_pm: customers pushing for a single discovery endpoint that answers: streaming support, json-schema output, tool calling, and explicit token limits. want to align on shape and launch must-haves.
aj_dev: +1. do we mean per-model flags or per-deployment flags?
sam_ml: per-model makes sense since some quantized variants lose streaming and some custom kernels restrict max_seq.
olivia_eng: ops/compat concern: if we change flags mid-rollout, clients might break if they cache discovery. need versioning.
maria_pm: launch criteria proposal: (1) discovery returns stable schema v1, (2) fields: supports_streaming, supports_json_schema, supports_tool_calls, max_input_tokens, max_total_tokens, tools[]. (3) at least 3 hosted models and 1 dedicated with full flags set.
aj_dev: can we also return fallback_model hints and latency tier? customers ask for cost vs latency choice.
sam_ml: latency_tier is fine as enum (low/med/high) but it's a heuristic. tool list should include per-tool capabilities e.g. sync vs async, streaming_supported.
olivia_eng: suggest endpoint: GET /v1/models/:model_id/manifest and GET /v1/models/_discovery?ids=... for batch. return ETag and schema_version.
maria_pm: agree on manifest path. how do we represent JSON schema support? boolean or schema_url?
aj_dev: boolean + optional schema_url for hosted verified schemas. boolean=false means model may produce structured output but we don't guarantee validation.
sam_ml: sample manifest snippet:```json
{
  "schema_version": "1",
  "model_id": "redwood-3b-q4",
  "supports_streaming": true,
  "supports_json_schema": true,
  "json_schema_url": "https://cdn.redwood.ai/schemas/redwood-3b-q4/response-v1.json",
  "supports_tool_calls": true,
  "tools": [
    {"name":"http_fetch","mode":"sync"},
    {"name":"calculator","mode":"sync"}
  ],
  "max_input_tokens": 8192,
  "max_total_tokens": 16384,
  "latency_tier": "low"
}
```

olivia_eng: nice. operational notes: ETag + cache-control 5m for hosted models, immediate invalidation on rollout. private deployments get manifest but schema_url may be null.
maria_pm: prioritization: customer asks prioritized by impact: (A) streaming+tooling for chatbots, (B) explicit token limits for embeddings/qa, (C) json-schema for structured extraction. estimated roadmap: A sprint 1, B sprint 2, C sprint 3.
aj_dev: engineering tradeoff: streaming requires runtime work for some quantized kernels. we can gate streaming flag until infra is validated.
sam_ml: also need evals for structured outputs: testset + schema conformance score. launch gates: >95% schema-conformance on canary.
olivia_eng: rollout policy: default manifest shows supports_* flags for current active variant, and include "compatible_variants": [ids] to allow graceful fallback. clients should recheck on 412/ETag mismatch.
maria_pm: action items: 1) eng to draft manifest API spec (aj), 2) ml to define schema conformance test (sam), 3) product to write launch criteria doc (maria). due EOW.
deploy-bot: new thread created: model-manifest-api-draft (1768123456) — assign aj_dev, sam_ml, maria_pm.
maria_pm: thanks — will sync tomorrow 10a to finalize scope. :thumbsup:
